issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the total-students accessor: the problem statement (including the prose task) refers to get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case) while the UML, template comments, and the Java solution use the camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch (snake_case vs. Java camelCase) can confuse students about the exact method name to implement and may cause mismatches with automated tests or style expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single canonical method name across all artifacts. Update problem_statement.md to refer to getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) to match the UML, template comments, and Java naming conventions. Ensure any code examples or prose in the problem statement and UML also use the same camelCase identifier so students and automated checks are not confused.
